rules.text: FastAPI requires Python, SQLAlchemy, uv, and pytest.
FastAPI and TypeScript backends disable each other.
Cloudflare Workers disables Express, Fastify, BullMQ, and Prisma.
MongoDB requires Mongoose and disables other ORMs.
Supabase Storage requires the Supabase provider and Postgres.
Better Auth and Auth.js require a database.
Full-stack single app disables a separate backend.
API only disables frontend and UI kits.
Vercel disables a separate backend other than Next route handlers.
Razorpay skill carries an INR note.
BullMQ requires Node or Bun and disables Workers and Python.
